questions.text:
Which one of the following is correct about the statements given below?
I. All function calls are resolved at compile time in C lang
II. All function calls are resolved at compile time in C++ lang
questions.solution:
Checking each statement:
- C: calls through function pointers are resolved at run time [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] I is false.
- C++: virtual functions are bound at run time (dynamic dispatch) [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] II is false.

Answer: Both I and II are incorrect

Click here for detail solution by gateoverflow
options: Both I and II are correct
Both I and II are incorrect
